findings.observed_claim: The local fallback computes and presents 7 unique displayed datasets, 8 fixed protocols, 39 displayed comparisons, and 9 methods. The same release data separately records 13 completed batch datasets and 69 completed batch comparisons; those larger numbers are not presented as the website release counts.
findings.claim_status: Scoped correctly in the local fallback; live production not verified.
findings.test_needed: Fetch production HTML plus /data/experiments.json and assert that the headline, Open Graph text, matrix dimensions, downloadable rows, and protocol tabs agree on 7 datasets, 8 protocols, 39 comparisons, and 9 methods. Add a scope test that prevents 13/69 full-batch counts from being labeled as displayed release counts.
evidence: site/src/pages/index.astro computes datasetCount from track dataset names and renders coverage.displayedProtocols/displayedComparisons.
site/src/data/mvp.json: displayedProtocols=8, displayedComparisons=39, completedBatchDatasets=13, completedBatchComparisons=69; row count=39; unique track datasets=7; unique row methods=9.
findings.accessibility_limitations: The deployed HTML and JSON could not be retrieved, so deployment drift, CDN caching, and broken production assets remain unchecked.

findings.observed_claim: The local fallback labels frozen foundation encoders and scratch-trained compact networks separately and says the scores do not establish optimal performance. It makes no explicit claim that pretraining helped. Scratch EEGNet is a different architecture, so it is not a random-initialization control for LaBraM or CBraMod.
findings.claim_status: Current wording is appropriately limited; causal pretraining benefit remains untested.
findings.test_needed: For each foundation architecture, compare the released pretrained checkpoint with a randomly initialized version of the same architecture under identical frozen-feature extraction, channel adapter, ridge head, folds, training budget, and several fixed seeds. Report paired participant-level differences and retain strong task baselines. Keep checkpoint-corpus overlap labeled unknown unless record-level manifests become available.
evidence: site/src/pages/data-use.astro says frozen encoders, scratch networks, and classical references are labeled separately.
All public protocol files state that pretraining overlap is unknown and make no unseen-pretraining claim.
docs/BCI Arena Dataset and Evaluation Expansion Research.md proposes same-architecture pretrained-versus-random controls.
findings.accessibility_limitations: Model dialogs and labels could not be checked on the deployed page.

findings.observed_claim: The local fallback describes participant-disjoint folds and descriptive participant-resampling 95% intervals. Most comparisons use one seed; only EEGNet on motor-imagery/rest and arithmetic/rest has a three-seed sensitivity check. Those seed ranges are explicitly not confidence intervals, and fold training sets overlap.
findings.claim_status: Disclosed, but insufficient for close model-ordering claims.
findings.test_needed: Automate leakage checks on subject/session membership and training-only preprocessing. Run multiple seeds for every stochastic trained model on prespecified priority tasks. For model comparisons, publish paired participant-level bootstrap or hierarchical intervals for score differences, alongside separate seed variability; do not infer superiority from overlapping marginal descriptive intervals.
evidence: Protocol JSON files specify participant-disjoint folds and training-only ridge standardization.
BETA, P300, semantic ERP, and sleep protocols say multi-seed sensitivity is pending.
The expansion memo records an EEGNet range of 2.83 percentage points on MI versus 0.28 on EEGMAT.
findings.accessibility_limitations: Production protocol downloads and chart flags were not interactively verified.

findings.observed_claim: The fallback reports BETA results for 4 and 8 electrodes selected from a 64-channel laboratory recording and explicitly says these subsets do not validate a physical low-channel headset. It also says prompted SSVEP does not measure idle false activations.
findings.claim_status: The limitation is correctly stated; no actual physical-cap performance claim was observed in the fallback.
findings.test_needed: Before making a hardware or dry-electrode claim, run a paired physical acquisition study with the same participants and task on wet and dry 8-channel hardware, frozen participant-disjoint splits, electrode/block-order controls, and paired confidence intervals. Report device transfer separately from channel-count ablation and from movement effects.
evidence: site/public/data/beta-4ch-protocol.json and beta-8ch-protocol.json contain the explicit physical-cap limitation.
The expansion memo prioritizes Zhu2021 paired wet/dry 8-channel SSVEP for this question.
findings.accessibility_limitations: The live wording and whether this caveat is visible without opening a protocol could not be verified.

findings.observed_claim: The fallback idle protocol contains only 180 seconds of test idle, 60 idle and 60 command trials across 4 evaluated participants, and resets detection at each cue. It explicitly says this cannot estimate natural always-on false activations per hour and warns that always abstaining can produce zero false activations.
findings.claim_status: The warning is scientifically appropriate; continuous reliability is not yet tested.
findings.test_needed: Use causal continuous recordings with no cue resets, prespecified window/merge/refractory logic, natural idle and mixed non-control states, and held-out participants. Report false command events per eligible idle hour with exposure and one-sided rate bounds per participant, plus command recall, wrong-command rate, latency, and risk-coverage curves. As a planning bound, zero errors over T idle hours still gives an approximate one-sided 95% upper rate of 3/T per hour under a homogeneous Poisson model.
evidence: site/public/data/idle-protocol.json: 4 participants, 180 seconds idle, cue-reset limitation.
docs/BCI Arena Dataset and Evaluation Expansion Research.md specifies continuous event-level scoring and the 3/T upper-bound heuristic.
findings.accessibility_limitations: The deployed tradeoff chart and its axis/caption pairing could not be checked.

findings.observed_claim: The fallback says every score carries its protocol, source, license, conditions, and limitations. Seven of eight protocol files expose audit, summary, and protocol hashes; the idle protocol exposes audit hashes but has no summarySha or protocolSha fields. All public protocols label checkpoint pretraining overlap unknown.
findings.claim_status: Substantial metadata is present locally, but the public release-to-frozen-artifact chain has not been verified end to end and is structurally less complete for idle.
findings.test_needed: For every one of the 39 displayed rows, validate a machine-readable chain from dataset DOI/version and rights review through source-file/sidecar hashes, split manifest, preprocessing and channel map, checkpoint identity/rights, predictions, aggregate summary, protocol, CSV, and release JSON. Recompute hashes from frozen artifacts, fail on missing links, add equivalent summary/protocol hashes for idle, and run production link/content-integrity checks after deployment.
evidence: site/src/pages/index.astro claims every score has the protocol that produced it and links source/protocol/download assets.
Seven non-idle protocol JSON files contain auditSha, summarySha, and protocolSha; idle-protocol.json contains auditSha but no summarySha/protocolSha.
docs/BCI Arena Benchmark Interpretation Caveats.md notes that decisive unit sidecars were not hashed in one withheld dataset package, motivating sidecar hashing as a release gate.
findings.accessibility_limitations: Production assets, redirects, source links, and hash correspondence could not be fetched; no claim is made that the live deployment currently has broken provenance.

overall_assessment: No unsupported physical-hardware, continuous-idle, pretraining-unseen, or universal-ranking claim was observed in the local fallback. The highest-priority next checks are production count/asset consistency, end-to-end provenance, and a real continuous idle evaluation. Same-architecture pretrained-versus-random controls, broader seed sensitivity, paired uncertainty, and paired physical-device data are the next scientific experiments needed before stronger comparative claims.
